children: said it would invest 3 billion ($3.31 billion) to expand its Gigafactory in Gruenheide, outside Berlin, its only plant in Europe. Tesla shares were down 3.03% as of 10:30 a.m. ET.

Tesla plans to build an additional production facility at the site with the aim of producing up to 1 million of its Cybercab robotaxis there. It will apply for a building permit before the end of the year, start construction in the first half of 2027 and begin production in 2029. The first phase will require several hundred new workers. Tesla has already ramped up Model Y production at the plant and hired more than 2,000 employees in recent months, and it aims to start battery cell production there from the middle of next year.

The plan contrasts with moves at Volkswagen and Mercedes-Benz, which are both considering closing plants in Germany, arguing that production costs there have become too high as low-cost Chinese rivals gain ground. Tesla said on Friday it was inviting select customers to buy a Cybercab for personal use.

title: Tesla Wants to Build 1 Million Cybercabs Near Berlin
